title: CI: add staging smoke tests for templates (RAG + agents) with telemetry assertions
author: Sahana Iyer
release_notes: Adds a CI smoke workflow that deploys/runs quickstart templates against staging Redwood API, validates basic RAG correctness, and asserts required telemetry contract fields are emitted.
body:
Summary: This PR adds end-to-end smoke tests that run our quickstart templates against the staging Hosted API and verify (1) we can complete a minimal RAG flow (ingest -> retrieve -> answer), (2) agents/tool-calling template can complete a tool call under timeouts/retries, and (3) the required telemetry contract v1 is emitted (trace attrs + log correlation fields + token usage metrics). This is intended to catch drift between docs/examples/templates and real API behavior before release, and to reduce support tickets related to missing timeouts/retries, missing request IDs, and broken OTel wiring.

Context / motivation: During dogfooding we repeatedly hit issues that were only visible when talking to a real endpoint (429 behavior, streaming disconnects behind proxies, tracing headers). Unit tests and local mocks didn’t catch these. This workflow is a gate to keep templates in a shippable state.

What’s included: 1) New GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/smoke-staging.yml` that runs nightly + on PRs labeled `run-smoke` (default is nightly to avoid staging load) and supports manual `workflow_dispatch`. 2) A `scripts/smoke/` harness that (a) sets up env var contract, (b) runs template containers in a controlled network, (c) executes deterministic smoke commands, (d) collects structured logs, and (e) queries trace/metric export for required fields. 3) Minimal data set + deterministic prompt set for RAG correctness sanity check. 4) Telemetry assertions aligned with telemetry contract v1 (required trace attributes and log fields) with cardinality guards (we only check presence + allowed value shapes).

Workflow behavior (high-level): - Uses `REDWOOD_API_KEY_STAGING` (GitHub Actions secret) and `REDWOOD_API_BASE_URL=https://api.staging.redwoodinference.com` (config) - Runs in two jobs: `rag_smoke` and `agents_smoke` (combined template can be added once the combined template stabilizes; follow-up in ENG-2844) - Each job: `docker compose up -d` (template + vector DB when applicable), wait for health checks, then `python scripts/smoke/run_*.py` - After runs: `python scripts/smoke/assert_telemetry.py` checks required log fields and trace attributes, plus presence of token usage cost fields in metrics

RAG correctness checks (intentionally minimal): - Ingest 3 small markdown docs into the default vector backend - Query “What is Redwood Dedicated?” expecting answer contains a short list of keywords: `Dedicated`, `reserved`, `predictable` - We avoid exact-match assertions to prevent brittleness across model updates; we use keyword + max latency + non-empty citations checks

Telemetry assertions (contract v1): - Logs: `timestamp`, `level`, `service.name`, `request_id`, `tenant_id` (or `tenant`), `route`, `model`, `error_class` (if error), `duration_ms` - Traces: spans include attrs `rw.request_id`, `rw.tenant`, `rw.route`, `rw.model`, `rw.deployment_mode`, `http.method`, `http.status_code` - Metrics: ensure at least one datapoint for `rw.llm.tokens.input`, `rw.llm.tokens.output`, `rw.llm.request.latency_ms` (names as implemented in templates), and verify values are non-negative

Guardrails / staging hygiene: - Concurrency limit: one workflow at a time via `concurrency: quickstarts-smoke-staging` - Rate limiting: harness enforces max 10 requests per job and backs off on 429 with jitter - Timeouts: each job hard-capped at 15 minutes; each API call capped (connect + read) to match template defaults

Files / areas changed: - `.github/workflows/smoke-staging.yml` - `scripts/smoke/run_rag_smoke.py` - `scripts/smoke/run_agents_smoke.py` - `scripts/smoke/assert_telemetry.py` - `scripts/smoke/lib/{compose.py,redwood_client.py,otel_capture.py,log_parse.py}` - `templates/python-rag/docker-compose.smoke.yml` (smoke override with smaller resources + deterministic ports) - `templates/typescript-agents/docker-compose.smoke.yml` - `datasets/smoke_docs/*` - `README.md` updates: “CI smoke tests” section and how to run locally with staging

How to test locally (maintainers): - Export `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and `REDWOOD_API_BASE_URL` to staging - `make smoke-rag` or `make smoke-agents` - Optional: `SMOKE_KEEP_CONTAINERS=1` to inspect logs

Notes / follow-ups: - Combined RAG+agent smoke is intentionally not included yet; will land after combined template API surface stops churning (tracked in ENG-2844). - We currently validate telemetry by parsing the local OTel collector export logs (file exporter) because querying Console directly is not available from CI; once we have a read-only telemetry query endpoint, we should switch to that.

Review conversation (highlights): - Logan Wright: “Please don’t assert exact metric names that might change; can we check a prefix or maintain a mapping file?” Author: Updated `assert_telemetry.py` to support a small mapping file `scripts/smoke/telemetry_contract_map.json` (kept in-repo) and to check presence of required attributes irrespective of exporter formatting. - Sean Gallagher: “Nightly is fine; PR gating on every PR will hammer staging. Add label-trigger + concurrency.” Author: Added label trigger (`run-smoke`) and concurrency group; nightly remains default. - Monica Patel: “Make sure retry behavior doesn’t mask real failures; avoid infinite retries on 429.” Author: Capped retries at 3 with exponential backoff + jitter; if 429 persists we fail with a clear message and include response headers in logs. - Wei Chen: “README needs a short section so Docs can link it; also call out required secrets.” Author: Added `CI smoke tests` section and documented required `REDWOOD_API_KEY_STAGING` secret.

CI status: - Initial run failed due to a missing `otel-collector-config.yaml` path in the compose override; fixed in commit `smoke: fix collector config mount`. - Re-ran successfully; jobs complete in ~9 minutes total.

Merge: Squash merged into `main`.
